items.title: Adrian Cunningham interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 31, 2021
items.q: He was a big support for me coming here. You know we’d hang out a lot.

ctx.x: Did you know other Australian musicians who had done the same think, like Lisa and Nicki Parrott? And did that have advice for you?

I knew of them. I think I met Nicki maybe a year or so after moving here, and we’ve played together a lot since then at a lot of festivals, and Nicki is one of the coolest. She’s great. But there’s some musicians in New York, because Nicki doesn’t live in New York, she lives in Connecticut so she wasn’t really kind of hanging out. But there are a couple of musicians here when I moved here, Jason Campbell, a guitar player. He has subsequently moved back to Australia. Since Covid he kind of moved his family over,…

come and hang out with him a lot. Nick Hampton is a saxophone player who’s been here for much longer than I have, another kind of good support to lean on. But other than that, no, I kind of just built my way up from the ground, go to jam sessions every night, I used to play in the park three or four days a week with guys that I’d met, and you know just all right, here we go, let’s do this.
